verses.text: When, therefore, man lives according to man, not according to God, he is like the devil.
verses.modernizedText: When, therefore, man lives according to man, not according to God, he is like the devil.

verses.text: Because not even an angel might live according to an angel, but only according to God, if he was to abide in the truth, and speak God’s truth and not his own lie.
verses.modernizedText: Because not even an angel might live according to an angel, but only according to God, if he was to abide in the truth, and speak God’s truth and not his own lie.

verses.text: And of man, too, the same apostle says in another place, “If the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie;”—“my lie,” he said, and “God’s truth.”
verses.modernizedText: And of man, too, the same apostle says in another place, “If the truth of God has more abounded through my lie;”—“my lie,” he said, and “God’s truth.”

verses.text: When, then, a man lives according to the truth, he lives not according to himself, but according to God; for He was God who said, “I am the truth.”
verses.modernizedText: When, then, a man lives according to the truth, he lives not according to himself, but according to God; for He was God who said, “I am the truth.”

verses.text: When, therefore, man lives according to himself,—that is, according to man, not according to God,—assuredly he lives according to a lie; not that man himself is a lie, for God is his author and creator, who is certainly not the author and creator of a lie, but because man was made upright, that he might not live according to himself, but according to Him that made him,—in other words, that he might do His will and not his own; and not to live as he was made to live, that is a lie.
verses.modernizedText: When, therefore, man lives according to himself,—that is, according to man, not according to God,—assuredly he lives according to a lie; not that man himself is a lie, for God is his author and creator, who is certainly not the author and creator of a lie, but because man was made upright, that he might not live according to himself, but according to Him that made him,—in other words, that he might do His will and not his own; and not to live as he was made to live, that is a lie.

verses.text: For he certainly desires to be blessed even by not living so that he may be blessed.
verses.modernizedText: For he certainly desires to be blessed even by not living so that he may be blessed.

verses.text: And what is a lie if this desire be not?
verses.modernizedText: And what is a lie if this desire be not?

verses.text: Wherefore it is not without meaning said that all sin is a lie.
verses.modernizedText: Wherefore it is not without meaning said that all sin is a lie.

verses.text: For no sin is committed save by that desire or will by which we desire that it be well with us, and shrink from it being ill with us.
verses.modernizedText: For no sin is committed save by that desire or will by which we desire that it be well with us, and shrink from it being ill with us.

verses.text: That, therefore, is a lie which we do in order that it may be well with us, but which makes us more miserable than we were.
verses.modernizedText: That, therefore, is a lie which we do in order that it may be well with us, but which makes us more miserable than we were.

verses.text: And why is this, but because the source of man’s happiness lies only in God, whom he abandons when he sins, and not in himself, by living according to whom he sins?
verses.modernizedText: And why is this, but because the source of man’s happiness lies only in God, whom he abandons when he sins, and not in himself, by living according to whom he sins?

verses.text: In enunciating this proposition of ours, then, that because some live according to the flesh and others according to the spirit, there have arisen two diverse and conflicting cities, we might equally well have said, “because some live according to man, others according to God.”
verses.modernizedText: In enunciating this proposition of ours, then, that because some live according to the flesh and others according to the spirit, there have arisen two diverse and conflicting cities, we might equally well have said, “because some live according to man, others according to God.”

verses.text: For Paul says very plainly to the Corinthians, “For whereas there is among you envying and strife, are ye not carnal, and walk according to man?”
verses.modernizedText: For Paul says very plainly to the Corinthians, “For whereas there is among you envying and strife, are you not carnal, and walk according to man?”

verses.text: So that to walk according to man and to be carnal are the same; for by flesh, that is, by a part of man, man is meant.
verses.modernizedText: So that to walk according to man and to be carnal are the same; for by flesh, that is, by a part of man, man is meant.

verses.text: For before he said that those same persons were animal whom afterwards he calls carnal, saying, “For what man knoweth the things of a man, save the spirit of man which is in him? even so the things of God knoweth no man, but the Spirit of God.
verses.modernizedText: For before he said that those same persons were animal whom afterwards he calls carnal, saying, “For what man knows the things of a man, save the spirit of man which is in him? even so the things of God knows no man, but the Spirit of God.

verses.text: Now we have received not the spirit of this world, but the Spirit which is of God; that we might know the things which are freely given to us of God.
verses.modernizedText: Now we have received not the spirit of this world, but the Spirit which is of God; that we might know the things which are freely given to us of God.

verses.text: Which things also we speak, not in the words which man’s wisdom teacheth, but which the Holy Ghost teacheth; comparing spiritual things with spiritual.
verses.modernizedText: Which things also we speak, not in the words which man’s wisdom teaches, but which the Holy Ghost teaches; comparing spiritual things with spiritual.

verses.text: But the animal man perceiveth not the things of the Spirit of God; for they are foolishness unto him.”
verses.modernizedText: But the animal man perceives not the things of the Spirit of God; for they are foolishness to him.”

verses.text: It is to men of this kind, then, that is, to animal men, he shortly after says, “And I, brethren, could not speak unto you as unto spiritual, but as unto carnal.”
verses.modernizedText: It is to men of this kind, then, that is, to animal men, he shortly after says, “And I, brethren, could not speak to you as to spiritual, but as to carnal.”

verses.text: And this is to be interpreted by the same usage, a part being taken for the whole.
verses.modernizedText: And this is to be interpreted by the same usage, a part being taken for the whole.

verses.text: For both the soul and the flesh, the component parts of man, can be used to signify the whole man; and so the animal man and the carnal man are not two different things, but one and the same thing, viz., man living according to man.
verses.modernizedText: For both the soul and the flesh, the component parts of man, can be used to signify the whole man; and so the animal man and the carnal man are not two different things, but one and the same thing, viz., man living according to man.

verses.text: In the same way it is nothing else than men that are meant either in the words, “By the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified;” or in the words, “Seventy-five souls went down into Egypt with Jacob.”
verses.modernizedText: In the same way it is nothing else than men that are meant either in the words, “By the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified;” or in the words, “Seventy-five souls went down into Egypt with Jacob.”

verses.text: In the one passage, “no flesh” signifies “no man;” and in the other, by “seventy-five souls” seventy-five men are meant.
verses.modernizedText: In the one passage, “no flesh” signifies “no man;” and in the other, by “seventy-five souls” seventy-five men are meant.

verses.text: And the expression, “not in words which man’s wisdom teacheth” might equally be “not in words which fleshly wisdom teacheth;” and the expression, “ye walk according to man,” might be “according to the flesh.”
verses.modernizedText: And the expression, “not in words which man’s wisdom teaches” might equally be “not in words which fleshly wisdom teaches;” and the expression, “you walk according to man,” might be “according to the flesh.”

verses.text: And this is still more apparent in the words which followed: “For while one saith, I am of Paul, and another, I am of Apollos, are ye not men?”
verses.modernizedText: And this is still more apparent in the words which followed: “For while one says, I am of Paul, and another, I am of Apollos, are you not men?”

verses.text: The same thing which he had before expressed by “ye are animal,” “ye are carnal, he now expresses by “ye are men;” that is, ye live according to man, not according to God, for if you lived according to Him, you should be gods.
verses.modernizedText: The same thing which he had before expressed by “you are animal,” “you are carnal, he now expresses by “you are men;” that is, you live according to man, not according to God, for if you lived according to Him, you should be gods.
